column1: # Production IEEE 802.11 LDPC packet-error-rate calibration for a 1458-byte reference PSDU.
# Curves were measured for HT mixed and VHT-SU with NSS=1 and are duplicated for 20 and 40 MHz.
# AWGN without fading. SNR is post-reception signal-to-noise ratio over occupied data+pilot tones
# excluding null/guard/DC tones; this SNR definition is bandwidth-independent.
# Each point represents 40000 simulated packets and PER is conditional on successful PHY-header reception.
# Nonzero PER samples are retained exactly as supplied. The supplied 0.00000 samples are represented by
# Rows contain the canonical LDPC planner signature for the 1458-byte calibration PSDU and are sorted canonically.
# Modeling assumption used by Ieee80211LdpcPerTable: for a calibrated format/bandwidth/per-stream-MCS tuple
# this PER-vs-SNR curve is reused unchanged for every standard LDPC payload/codeword size and for NSS>1
# ideal separated streams. HT MCS 8..31 reuse MCS modulo 8; VHT uses its MCS unchanged.
# Structural planner columns are strict validation/provenance
# Interpolation is linear in log10(PER) versus SNR in dB; no interpolation is performed across calibrated-mode keys.
